objects.description: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has poisoned npm packages with fake runtime dependencies to trigger execution of malicious payloads on developer endpoints or continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) systems during npm installation or update.(Citation: Microsoft Axios Compromise APR 2026)(Citation: MIcrosoft Mastra npm Compromise JUN 2026)
